concept.en: When to remove the newest item and when to remove the oldest item
concept.zh: 何时移除最新元素，何时移除最旧元素

original_source_excerpt.en: A stack returns the newest item; a queue returns the oldest item.
original_source_excerpt.zh: 栈返回最新元素；队列返回最旧元素。

sources.rights: Original synthetic teaching text created for this competition; no school, course, or learner records.

text.en: A stack stores items in insertion order and removes the newest item first. A queue stores items in insertion order and removes the oldest item first.
text.zh: 栈按插入顺序存储元素，并优先移除最新元素；队列也按插入顺序存储元素，但优先移除最旧元素。

body.en: Look at a single add or remove before reading the next one.
body.zh: 在继续看下一个操作前，先理解当前一个增删操作。

body.en: push(A), push(B), push(C) leaves C on top; pop returns C.
body.zh: push(A)、push(B)、push(C) 后 C 在顶部；pop 返回 C。

body.en: enqueue(A), enqueue(B), enqueue(C) leaves A at the front; dequeue returns A.
body.zh: enqueue(A)、enqueue(B)、enqueue(C) 后 A 在前端；dequeue 返回 A。

visual_spec.pedagogical_reason: Contrast the removal rule of a stack with the removal rule of a queue.
visual_spec.visual_goal: Show stack-to-LIFO and queue-to-FIFO as two grounded branches.

source_grounding.supported_claim: Stack removes newest; queue removes oldest.

alt_text.en: Diagram contrasting stack removal with queue removal.
alt_text.zh: 对比栈与队列移除规则的示意图。

long_description.en: The diagram has two branches. Stack points to the rule newest first. Queue points to the rule oldest first.
long_description.zh: 图中有两条分支：栈指向“最新元素先出”；队列指向“最旧元素先出”。

definition.en: The last item added is the first item removed.
definition.zh: 最后加入的元素最先被移除。

definition.en: The first item added is the first item removed.
definition.zh: 最先加入的元素最先被移除。

prompt.en: push(A), push(B), push(C) then pop returns which value?
prompt.zh: push(A)、push(B)、push(C) 后执行 pop，返回什么？

rationale.en: C was added last, so a stack removes C first.
rationale.zh: C 最后加入，所以栈最先移除 C。

prompt.en: enqueue(A), enqueue(B), enqueue(C) then dequeue returns which value?
prompt.zh: enqueue(A)、enqueue(B)、enqueue(C) 后执行 dequeue，返回什么？

rationale.en: A was added first, so a queue removes A first.
rationale.zh: A 最先加入，所以队列最先移除 A。

rationale.en: Stacks remove the most recently added item.
rationale.zh: 栈移除最近加入的元素。
